sn14.33:2.4: But since there is gratification in the air element, sentient beings are aroused by it.
sn14.33:2.5: If the air element had no drawback, sentient beings wouldn’t grow disillusioned with it.
sn14.33:2.6: But since the air element has a drawback, sentient beings do grow disillusioned with it.
sn14.33:2.7: If there were no escape from the air element, sentient beings wouldn’t escape from it.
sn14.33:2.8: But since there is an escape from the air element, sentient beings do escape from it.
